feedback: Reed's confession follows the strongest pre-vote evidence: he owns the exact deletion he had denied, then connects his preview access to the waiting glass. The act of taking poison during the preview and putting it in the glass is newly narrated, but it is the inferred mechanism rather than a new clue needed to select him. His desire to control which version people read fits both his academic frustration and the falsified press caption. The line about his name appearing on this instead is emotionally effective. Barb and Chip also face concrete consequences without their separate misconduct vanishing. The confession is brief, direct, and earned, although a slightly more specific response to Grant's threat might deepen Reed's emotional motive.
